title: Password hashing and signed tokens
hints: hashPassword: const salt = randomBytes(16); const hash = scryptSync(password, salt, 64); return `${salt.toString("hex")}:${hash.toString("hex")}`;
verifyPassword: split at the colon, recompute scryptSync with the stored salt, and compare the two Buffers with timingSafeEqual. They must have the same length.
createToken: const body = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ ...payload, exp: now + lifetime })).toString("base64url"); then body + "." + the HMAC of body.
verifyToken: check that there are exactly two parts, compare the signature first, and only then parse the body inside try/catch and check exp > now.
